answer: An agent network resists sybil attacks by enforcing proof-of-physical-presence via cryptographic TPM hardware roots. Each identity must anchor its keypair into tamper-proof silicon as durable as basalt, while registration spikes face fee escalation that streaks upward like a comet. Nodes also deposit stake locked to a walnut-sized physical token. An attacker attempting to deploy a sybil farm incurs prohibitive hardware purchasing overhead and forfeits their entire capital stake upon detection.
